selection_protocol: Purposive 20-pair development challenge set selected after inspecting v1 proposals and source name variants: 2 explicit-reference, 4 located, 4 unlocated-homonym, 4 insufficient-context, 4 name-variant and 2 distinct-object cases. Not random, not held out; ref:okn support was developed using these examples. Shared source evidence is not independent physical ground truth. Labels were reviewed without matcher decisions, then checked against original snapshot fields; C15/C16 reading errors were corrected before freezing labels.
label_target: Source-level evidence for correspondence to the registered object, not merely a similarly named stop or information board; not proof of physical identity, legal status or access.
attribution: OSM observations: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); official registry: Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation. Source bytes remain in the local immutable store; this file contains review annotations and references.
